answers.question: Could this be a real trip?

answer.text: The GEO_IMPOSSIBLE signal shows the card moved 1,033 km in 90 seconds, implying a speed of 41,312 km/h, which far exceeds the 900 km/h max speed threshold.
Such a speed is physically impossible for any mode of travel, indicating the card was likely used in two distant locations at the same time.
The user’s 24‑hour history shows 118 past transactions with an average amount of 1,057 rupees and no prior travel‑related anomalies, so this pattern is not typical for the account.
No recent similar GEO_IMPOSSIBLE cases were found; the only close match involved a velocity rule rather than a legitimate trip.
